lines.text: @maya_front reaches the mountain summit, drops her backpack, and spreads her arms in the wind above the clouds.
Drone pull-out to reveal the peaks.

new_beats.text: Sunlight breaks over @peak_dawn and warms her face as she laughs.

writes.note: I added a moment at 3 s where the sunrise hits her face, and left your words as they were.

reply.rationale: The shot had the arrival and the pull-out but no payoff. A short sunrise-and-laugh beat after she spreads her arms adds one visual moment without changing the action.
